# Virtual disk manager

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Built-in tools and hand-off · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

src/deploy/targets.ts + src/deploy/ui.ts Virtual disks view (list, create .vhd/.vhdx, attach, detach via diskpart), tests/deploy.test.ts

## What is missing

not in the editor app; grow, shrink, compact, convert, differencing chains/merge, VHD Set, ISO attach, Dev Drive, native boot; route name and equivalent script; Quick pack; site article; never run on real Windows
